title: Making Weekend Plans
introduction: به جمله‌های دعوت و پاسخ مثبت یا منفی دقت کن. سپس مکالمه را با یک دوست تمرین کن.
paragraphs: Emma: Are you free on Friday evening?
Emma: Would you like to watch a movie with me?
Noah: That sounds great. What time?
Emma: The movie starts at seven. Let's meet at half past six.
Noah: Perfect. Where should we meet?
Emma: In front of the cinema.
